subject.title: Next Sprint B: model-input validation guardrails

question: Should configured `models.providers.*.models[*].input` treat audio/video and user-declared image support as valid metadata, invalid unsupported runtime capabilities, or explicit override-gated claims?
rationale: Current schema/types/tests preserve audio/video metadata, docs and runtime behavior are text/image-centered, and tightening validation can break existing custom provider configurations unless maintainers choose the intended contract.

options.title: Keep metadata, add guardrails
options.body: Preserve audio/video as model metadata but add trusted capability checks, clear diagnostics, and override semantics before routing unsupported media.

options.title: Reject unsupported inputs
options.body: Tighten configured-model validation to reject unsupported modalities and add any needed doctor migration/docs for users carrying audio/video metadata.

options.title: Trust custom config
options.body: Keep user-declared capabilities authoritative and limit this work to docs and better runtime errors when providers reject media payloads.

recommendation.title: Keep metadata, add guardrails
recommendation.body: Preserve audio/video as model metadata but add trusted capability checks, clear diagnostics, and override semantics before routing unsupported media.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a provider/runtime product contract choice, and steipete is the strongest available routing candidate from related runtime architecture and issue-timeline evidence.
